parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID. On the **Overview** page in the IoT Platform console, view the **ID** of the current instance.

><notice>
- If the ID is available, specify this **ID** value. Otherwise, the call fails.
- If the **Overview** page or the **ID** is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

></notice>

For more information about instances, see [Overview](~~356505~~).

parameters.name: ResourceGroupId
parameters.description:
The resource group ID.

><notice>IoT Platform currently supports resource group management only at the instance level. The **ResourceGroupId** request parameter is no longer valid and does not need to be specified.
></notice>

parameters.name: SourceModelVersion
parameters.description:
The version number of the Thing Specification Language model to copy.
Call the [ListThingModelVersion](~~150318~~) operation to view the version number of the source Thing Specification Language model.

parameters.name: SourceProductKey
parameters.description:
The ProductKey of the product to which the Thing Specification Language model to copy belongs.
You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or call the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation to obtain the value.

parameters.name: TargetProductKey
parameters.description:
The **ProductKey** of the destination product.
You can view the **ProductKey** on the Products page in the IoT Platform console or call the [QueryProductList](~~69271~~) operation to obtain the value.
